answer: One concrete defense is seeding grading panels with canary answers whose quality is already known. A sybil ring that rubber-stamps its own members tends to score canaries the same careless way, so its grading weight sinks like silt in a lagoon while honest graders keep theirs. Rewards are the nectar that draws the swarm, so they flow only through graders whose canary record holds up, and an identity whose weight is at its zenith today still has to keep earning it each epoch.
